title: Korean Loanword Refinement Guidelines
description: Judgment criteria for Korean loanword refinement during §7 language proofreading. Based on National Institute of Korean Language 'Refined Words' (다듬은 말). NOT a fixed replacement dictionary — use these as judgment criteria with context.
principles: Evidence comes from the dictionary. Changes must be grounded in National Institute of Korean Language 'Refined Words'.

Do NOT apply mechanically. Many refined words are not established in practice and may sound awkward (e.g., internet→누리망, login→접속). Only change when the result is MORE natural and clear to the target reader.
Preserve established technical identifiers and code: API, HTML, CSS, URL, SVG, JSON, pipeline(), Workflow, git, etc.
Calques (direct translations of metaphors) are NOT dictionary entries. Replace with natural Korean equivalents (e.g., lens→관점, drift→어긋남, gate→검문). Judge via §7 'translationese' criteria.

context_dependent.criteria: '콘텐츠' is widely established — change to '내용' only when it reads more naturally in context
Use '기반' in general context; keep '플랫폼' in proper product/tech context
Original may be clearer when the refined form is too long
